blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ClearSkiiin took the solo lead in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference after surviving winless but gritty Armed Forces of the Philippines in five sets, 25-12, 25-12, 24-26, 14-25, 15-9, on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. After pulling off a five-set comeback against VNS before the Halloween break, the UV Smashers blew a two-set advantage this time, but turned to go-to scorers JM Ronquillo and Louis Gamban to regain their form in the fifth and add to the Cavaliers’ woes.
